description: MCP tool contract for the support assistant (S7). Frozen in S0 so the LLM bench and the MCP server use the same schemas.

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.description: Version, training window and evaluation metrics of the model currently serving predictions.

tools.name: predict_duration
tools.description: Predict the duration in minutes of a yellow-taxi trip between two NYC TLC taxi zones, using the champion model.

pickup_zone.description: TLC taxi zone name for the pickup, e.g. 'JFK Airport' or 'Times Sq/Theatre District'.

dropoff_zone.description: TLC taxi zone name for the dropoff.

hour.description: Pickup hour, 24h clock, New York local time.

tools.name: query_zone_stats
tools.description: Historical trip statistics for one pickup zone from the zone_hour_stats mart.

hour.description: Optional: restrict to one pickup hour.
